_doc: CT-02 sabotage modifiers. Each file in /client/modifiers exports meta and applyModifier(el,{duration,strength}) -> remove(). Durations/strengths come from balance.json sabotage.*; 'strength' is 0..1.

modifiers.name: Turbo
modifiers.description: Everything in their minigame runs faster (stacks with the round's speed ramp).

modifiers.name: Mirror Mode
modifiers.description: Mirrors the minigame left-to-right. Taps still land where they look.
modifiers.pick: Flip their screen like a mirror.

modifiers.name: Tiny Buttons
modifiers.description: Shrinks every button. Still tappable, just fiddly.

modifiers.name: Earthquake
modifiers.description: Shakes the minigame around a few pixels.

modifiers.name: False Alarm
modifiers.description: Flashes fake ALARM warnings that do nothing (taps pass straight through).

modifiers.name: Lockout
modifiers.description: Disables one control for a couple of seconds at a time, then moves on.

modifiers.name: Jam the Signal
modifiers.description: Static noise and twitching controls. Also the Hacker vs. Hacker scramble.
